intro1.say: Meet AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding plugin for Claude Code and Antigravity.
intro1.cap: Meet AlphaEvolve — evolutionary algorithm discovery for coding agents.

intro2.say: Instead of stopping at a first draft, it evolves algorithms against an automated evaluator.
intro2.cap: Iteratively mutates and benchmarks code inside # EVOLVE-BLOCK.

scaffold.say: First, it scaffolds an initial baseline and verifies correctness against a reference oracle.

mutate1.say: In Mode A, the agent samples top parents, writes a hypothesis, and mutates the evolve block.
mutate1.cap: 2 · Agent-driven loop: sample → hypothesis rationale → evaluate.

mutate2.say: Across three generations, the knapsack solver climbs from greedy to optimal dynamic programming.

zoom_map.say: Every candidate, parent lineage, and runtime metric is tracked live in the MAP-Elites archive.
zoom_map.cap: Live 2× zoom: MAP-Elites fitness progression & parent lineage.

guardrails.say: Held-out verification prevents overfitting, while Blind Mode protects private datasets from leaking into agent context.
guardrails.cap: 3 · Guardrails: --held-out split, MAX_CODE_CHARS, and BLIND_MODE = True.

outro.say: Available now for Claude Code and Antigravity. Thanks for watching!
